mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, reconciliation_status, channel_id, logistics_bill_id, actual_weight, volume_weight, billing_weight, estimated_shipping_cost , billing_weight_logistics, actual_shipping_cost, diff_shipping_cost, currency, remark
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE ( sum(cd.cost_value),0) FROM logistics_bill AS lb inner JOIN logistics_bill_cost AS lbc ON lb.ID = lbc.logistics_bill_id AND lbc.is_deleted = FALSE inner JOIN tms_cost_detail AS cd ON cd.main_id = lbc.id and cd.is_deleted = false inner JOIN tms_cfg_cost AS cc ON cc.id = cd.cfg_cost_id and cc.is_deleted = false WHERE lb.is_deleted = FALSE and cc.dict_cost_category = 'shippingCost' and cd.type = 'actual' and lb.source_id = #{soId}
